scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I'm checking on the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it a while ago and wanted to see if it was approved or denied. Can you look it up for me?
dialogue.agent: Sure, I'd be happy to help. I've looked up your application, and I can confirm that your loan has been originated — meaning it was approved and the funds have been disbursed.

dialogue.user: Oh, that's great news! I'm relieved to hear it was approved. Could you tell me what my interest rate is and what the total loan costs are?
dialogue.agent: Of course. Your interest rate is 6.5%, and the total loan costs come to $4,502.51.

dialogue.user: 6.5% — okay, I was hoping for maybe a bit lower but I understand. And what about the loan term — I think I applied for a 30-year term, is that correct? Also, are there any high-cost flags or negative amortization features on this loan?
dialogue.agent: Yes, your loan term is 360 months, which is 30 years. This is a conventional, first-lien home purchase loan. It is not a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: That's reassuring to know there aren't any hidden high-cost or negative amortization issues. Has my loan been sold or transferred to another institution, or is it still with your company?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was sold to Fannie Mae after origination.

dialogue.user:
I see, that's good to know. Thanks for letting me know upfront. I think I have a pretty clear picture now. I really appreciate you answering all my questions clearly and honestly — it made me feel informed and at ease.

<Very Satisfied> - I'm very satisfied with the interaction. The agent was polite, knowledgeable, and gave me all the information I needed without making me feel rushed or confused.
